# ── MEASURED BLOCK (composite-materialization A/B, 2026-09-01) ──────────────────────
# The MXHRVP composite-materialization MECHANISM is confirmed working in the oracle:
# FVSppe applies the SELECTED harvest via the base-FVS ACTIVITY-GROUP-LABEL mechanism —
# hvreps.f keeps the MSPLABEL in a selected stand's label set (deletes it for not-selected;
# it never sets an IF(SELECTED) variable — SELECTED is UNDEFINED during real projection),
# so an AGPLABEL-labeled activity group (here the THINBTA) fires iff the stand is selected.
# Above golden proves it: BA/acre 77→23, 500 TPA / 3003 BdFt removed, FRACTION TREATED=1.0.
#
# The FVSjl composite A/B is BLOCKED by a base-THINBTA divergence (NOT an MXHRVP defect):
# FVSjl's THINBTA to residual 40 removes ESSENTIALLY ALL trees on this EC stand (before-thin
# BA 2000 ≈ 0.0), whereas the oracle thins to the residual and regrows (BA 2000 = 28).
# Reproduced on the 2-field (THINBTA 1990 40) and 3-field (…40 1.0) cards. This is a base
# THIN-keyword semantics/scaling issue to investigate separately; the MXHRVP materialization
# LOGIC (re-project selected stands with the thin, split status-4 by HVPART, aggregate via the
# oracle-validated _ppe_aggregate) is composable and gated only on the base THIN matching.
